rationale: New public subscriptions use Shopify App Pricing and the Partner API Active Subscription query. Existing Billing API subscriptions remain readable and entitled until they are migrated with Shopify's migration tooling; the app must not create new Billing API subscriptions once SHOPIFY_BILLING_MODE=shopify_app_pricing.

requires: Configure Starter, Growth, Pro, Unlimited on the Live Shopify app only.
Set a 10-day free trial on every Live public plan.
Configure plan descriptions and welcome link on the Live App Store listing.
Use the Partner API client to read Live-app subscription state.
Keep Local/Dev and Staging on manual_legacy test billing.
Test Shopify App Pricing by installing the Live app on a development store in the same Partner organization.
Migrate existing Live Billing API subscriptions before those merchants change plans.

subscription_read_order: legacy Admin API activeSubscriptions fallback for unmigrated Billing API merchants

manual_pricing_legacy_compatibility.migration_method: Partner Dashboard subscription migration tool or Shopify CLI subscription-migrations
manual_pricing_legacy_compatibility.access_policy: Local/Dev and Staging may create Billing API test subscriptions. Live must not create new Billing API subscriptions once Shopify App Pricing is enabled; existing Live Billing API subscriptions remain entitled until migration.

local_dev.purpose: Local development and Billing API test subscriptions only. No App Store listing or Shopify App Pricing catalog.

staging.purpose: Hosted pre-production functional/runtime testing with Billing API test subscriptions. This app does not own the App Store listing or public pricing catalog.

production_live.purpose: Only App Store submission identity. Owns public Shopify App Pricing plans and merchant production billing.
